app.name: When We Meet
app.tagline: Find a time that works for everyone.

guest.headline: See everyone’s availability at a glance.
guest.body: Sign in to create a meeting and find a time together.
guest.signInRegion: Sign in to When We Meet
guest.signInToCreate: Sign in with Google to create a meeting
guest.draftKept: Your draft stays in this tab. Sign in, then press Create meeting again.

list.emptyBody:
Create a meeting to find a time together,
or join one with an invitation link.

create.dialogDescription: Choose the dates and times, then create your meeting.
create.linkHint: Anyone with this link can join with Google.

picker.rangeGuidance: Select a start date, then an end date up to 14 consecutive days later. Selecting an earlier date starts a new range. The range is saved when you choose the end date; Escape keeps the previous range.
picker.noLaterTimes: No later times available. Choose an earlier start time.
picker.tooLong: That end date is more than 14 days after {start}. Choose an earlier end date.
picker.currentRange: Current range {start} to {end}, {days} days. Choose a new start date to replace it.

room.loadErrorDetail: Check your connection and try again.
room.sectionLoadFailed: Couldn’t load this part of the page
room.notConfigured: This service is not connected to Supabase yet. No meeting or availability can be saved. Ask the site owner to configure the shared project and review the migration. Google login must be enabled before meeting actions can work.
room.findingTimes: Finding the times you’re planning together.

grid.dragHint: Drag on one day to choose a time

instructions.anchor: Start set at {time}. Press Enter or Space on a later half-hour of the same day to set the end.
instructions.select: Arrow keys move between half-hours and days. Enter or Space sets the start, then the end; Shift with Up or Down stretches the range. On touch, tap twice or long-press and drag.
instructions.readOnly: Read-only view of saved availability. Arrow keys move between half-hours and days; each half-hour names who is free. Enter or Space opens the details of the first person there.
instructions.edit: Click or drag to edit your availability. Arrow keys move between half-hours and days, Enter or Space toggles one, Shift with an arrow extends. On touch, tap toggles and long-press then drag selects a range.

fill.intro: Preview the half-hours your calendar shows as free, then fill them.
fill.none: No free half-hours on these dates
fill.connectPrompt: Connect Google Calendar to see when you’re free.
fill.connected: Google Calendar connected. Use Fill from Google Calendar to preview your free time.
fill.denied: Google Calendar wasn’t connected. Your selection is unchanged.
fill.permissionMissing: Tick the Google Calendar permission to continue
fill.connectFailed: Couldn’t connect Google Calendar. Try again.

people.heading: People
people.empty: No one has joined this meeting yet.

confirm.heading: Confirm a time
confirm.reviewDescription: Check the exact time and recipients before sending invitations.

warnings.missingEmail: Missing email for {names}. Exclude these members before sending.
warnings.noLongerWorks: This time no longer works for everyone

confirm.consent: Connect the organizer’s Google Calendar before sending. Connecting doesn’t send invitations.
confirm.sendFailed: Couldn’t send the invitations. Review the details and try again.
confirm.reconciling: Checking event status. Checking again never sends invitations twice.
confirm.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the confirmation. Check your connection and try again.
confirm.calendarUnavailable: Google Calendar connection is unavailable. Try again.
confirm.reconcilingNoRetry: Checking event status. Please don’t retry yet.
confirm.submitted: Request submitted. Waiting for verified status.

errors.selectionChanged: The selected time changed. Review again.
errors.outsideWindow: That time is outside the meeting window.
errors.eventName: Enter an event name (up to 100 characters).
errors.reload: Reload the meeting and review again.
errors.lastAttemptFailed: The last confirmation attempt didn’t finish. Review the details and try again.
errors.reconnect: Connect Google Calendar to send invitations. Connecting doesn’t send anything; review again afterward.
errors.changed: The proposed time or recipients changed. Review again.
errors.notOwner: Only the meeting owner can do this.
errors.conflict: This meeting changed since you opened it. Reload and review again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again, then review.
errors.google: Google Calendar didn’t complete the request. Try again to check the status; nothing is sent twice.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Try again to check the invitation status; it won’t send twice.

confirmed.updatedByOrganizer: Updated by the organizer after the first invitation.
confirmed.notIncluded: Confirmed by {name} · You weren’t included in the invitation
confirmed.notIncludedAnon: Confirmed by the organizer · You weren’t included in the invitation
confirmed.organizerWillChoose: The organizer will choose a time and send invitations.
confirmed.organizerSending: The organizer is sending invitations. Check back shortly.

edit.title: Edit confirmed meeting
edit.hint: Pick a new time on the calendar, then review the changes.
edit.reconciling: Saving your changes to Google Calendar. Checking again never notifies attendees twice.
edit.reviewDescription: Google Calendar updates the same event and emails attendees about the change. Removed recipients receive a cancellation.

errors.google: Google Calendar didn’t complete the change. Check again to see what was saved; attendees aren’t notified twice.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check again to see whether your changes were saved; attendees aren’t notified twice.

resend.body: Google Calendar sends the same invitation again.

errors.reconnect: Connect Google Calendar to resend invitations.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.tooSoon: Invitations were just sent. Try again in a minute.
errors.notAllowed: Invitations can be resent only for a confirmed meeting with no pending changes.
errors.network: Couldn’t resend invitations. Try again in a minute.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: What everyone sees, and your name in this meeting.

scheduleWarningLost.one: {count} saved half-hour from {names} falls outside the new times and will be removed.
scheduleWarningLost.other: {count} saved half-hours from {names} fall outside the new times and will be removed.

settings.scheduleConfirmedStays: The confirmed time and its invitations stay as they are.
settings.deleteHint: Removes the meeting and everyone’s availability.
settings.deleteBody: Everyone loses access to this meeting and its saved availability. This can’t be undone.
settings.deleteCalendarNote: The Google Calendar event isn’t cancelled; cancel it in Google Calendar if needed.
settings.scheduleFailed: Couldn’t update the dates and times.

invitation.heading: Meeting invitation
invitation.guestBody: Continue with Google to join this meeting and share your availability.
invitation.memberBody: Joining this meeting gives you access to its availability.
invitation.invalid: This invitation link is incomplete or invalid. Ask the organizer for a new link.
invitation.privacyNote: Only people with the complete invitation link can join. Keep it private.
invitation.storageUnavailable: This browser can’t keep the invitation through Google sign-in. Allow storage for this site and try again.

auth.restoring: Restoring your session and returning to your meeting. Your draft will remain in this tab.
auth.failed: Couldn’t complete Google sign-in. Try again.
auth.expired: The sign-in attempt expired. Try Google sign-in again.
auth.unavailableHere: Google sign-in isn’t available on this address. Open hyeok.dev to sign in.
auth.unavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable. Try again.
auth.returnToMeetings: Return to meetings and try again

validation.title: Enter a title (up to 100 characters).
validation.endAfterStart: End time must be later than start time.
validation.datesRequired: Choose a start and end date.
validation.pastDates: Choose dates that are not in the past.
validation.name: Enter your name (up to 50 characters).

errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.create: Couldn’t create the meeting. Try again.
errors.createInvalid: Check the meeting details and try again.
errors.join: Couldn’t join this meeting. Try again.
errors.notOwner: Only the meeting owner can change this.
errors.conflict: This meeting changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
errors.invalidSchedule: Check the dates and times and try again.
